summary_en: SBI Holdings and SBI NM LLC extended the tender offer period for BASE Inc. (TSE Growth: 4477) to October 21, 2026, comprising 34 business days. The offer price remains 340 yen per share with a maximum purchase target of 23,792,300 shares (20.67% post-acquisition ownership). The extension followed notification that a major shareholder intends to resume purchasing BASE shares to raise their stake above 30% starting October 2.
title_en: Notice of Amendments to Notification of Commencement of Tender Offer and Announcement of Capital and Business Alliance Agreement for BASE Inc. (Securities Code: 4477) in Connection with Amendment Notification to Tender Offer Notification
translation_en_brief:
SBI Holdings, Inc. (SBIHD) and its affiliate SBI NM LLC (collectively, the offerors) have extended the tender offer period for BASE Inc. shares listed on the TSE Growth market (code 4477) to October 21, 2026, totaling 34 business days. The offer was originally launched on August 31, 2026, at 340 yen per share with a maximum purchase target of 23,792,300 shares. Upon completion, the offerors would hold approximately 20.67% of BASE based on voting rights as of June 30, 2026.

The extension became necessary following notification received on October 1, 2026, that Hiroyuki Maki, a major shareholder of BASE, intends to resume purchasing BASE shares starting October 2 with the objective of raising his stake above 30%. BASE's board of directors continues to support the tender offer and has expressed its position that shareholders should make their own decision on whether to participate.

The tender offer originally was scheduled to close on October 15, 2026 (30 business days). The amended period ending October 21 represents an extension of four business days. The offer price of 340 yen per share and maximum share target remain unchanged. This represents a holding structure as an equity-method affiliate under applicable accounting standards.
